name: CalPERS

summary.text: The California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) is the largest public pension fund in the United States. Its Public Employees' Retirement Fund had a market value of about $563 billion at June 30, 2025, after an 11.6% return for fiscal year 2024–25. Public equity made up roughly 39% of the fund; private equity returned about 14.3% for the year and the board's target allocation to private equity was raised to 17% from 13%.

sources.title: CalPERS Announces Preliminary 11.6% Return for 2024-25 Fiscal Year

facts.claim: CalPERS reported an 11.6% total-fund return for fiscal year 2024–25 and a Public Employees' Retirement Fund market value of $563.0 billion at fiscal year-end.
CalPERS's July 2025 preliminary announcement estimated fund assets at approximately $556.2 billion; the final year-end figure was $563.0 billion.

sources.title: CalPERS Announces Preliminary 11.6% Return for 2024-25 Fiscal Year

facts.claim: CalPERS said its private equity portfolio returned 14.3% in fiscal 2024–25, which it attributed partly to a 2022 strategy change adding co-investments; public equity made up about 39% of the fund.

sources.title: CalPERS Announces Preliminary 11.6% Return for 2024-25 Fiscal Year

facts.claim: The CalPERS board raised the fund's target allocation to private equity to 17% from 13%.

sources.title: 7 Things to Know About Our Financial Report

facts.claim: At June 30, 2024 CalPERS held about $79.7 billion in private equity within a $551.4 billion portfolio, according to its annual investment report.

openQuestions: The site's Blind Pool page lists CalPERS among public pension funds supplying capital to venture and private-equity managers; which specific managers or funds the page has in mind was not identified, so no connection is recorded. CalPERS's annual investment report lists its private-equity commitments by manager and could support such links.
The 2024-25 ACFR (calpers.ca.gov/documents/acfr-2025/download) was not opened; figures come from CalPERS's fact sheet and press release.
